blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 14-year-old motorcycle back-rider was killed while two other riders were wounded in a shooting incident in Calamba City, Laguna, on Sunday, police said. In a report on Monday, the Police Regional Office 4A said the victims were aboard a motorcycle in Barangay Parian at around 11 a.m. when an unidentified gunman suddenly appeared and repeatedly shot them. Police confirmed that the victims included the teenage boy, the motorcycle driver, and another woman who was also riding at the back of the vehicle.
